scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed — Tol colorblind-safe palette with HCL depth-lightness hierarchy, clean typographic system (white 12px group labels, 10px leaf labels, 9px monospace sizes), and polished breadcrumb/zoom interaction, but leaf-cell readability is marginal at the root view and the legend swatches show base palette colors rather than the HCL-adjusted tones actually used in the cells.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is correctly proportional via d3.treemap().sum() with data-driven scale domains, but leaf cell fill calls a stateful RNG during render, making leaf colors render-order-dependent and violating the permutation invariant for that visual channel.
scores.stress_test_note: Interrupt pattern and named transitions are correctly used; only minor issue is updateVisibility computing label show/hide from the already-updated final-state scale while the zoom transition is still in flight, causing labels to pop in/out before cells reach their final size.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 8 categorical colors map cleanly to well-separated top-level regions, label overflow is suppressed below minimum cell size, and the zoom interaction progressively reveals depth rather than showing all ~471 files at once — the static root view is dense but structured.

proposer: 337 lines, down from 351 (-14 lines). Changes: inlined `branchOf` into `cellFill`, inlined `pathOf` into tooltip handler, simplified margin to a single constant.
